title: A brand-new hole in the Moon

games.label: REAL OR A REACH?
games.title: Did this actually happen?
games.claim: NASA’s Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter spotted the huge new McGetchin crater within a week of the impact in 2024.
games.why: The crater formed between 11 April and 22 May 2024, but nobody noticed it until 24 October 2025. That’s when image specialist Robert Wagner found it by comparing before-and-after LRO pictures.
sources: Universe Today · Details of new crater

games.label: MAKE THE CONNECTION
games.title: Three terms. Find their partners.
pairs: How often an impact this big is expected
games.why: McGetchin crater is about 222 m across, or roughly two football pitches, and about 43 m deep. Models suggest an impact this big hits the Moon only about once every 130 years.
sources: NASA APOD · A new lunar crater

games.label: THREE CLUES, ONE STORY
games.title: What connects these three stories?
clues: A NASA orbiter that has circled the Moon for more than 17 years
Before-and-after photos reveal a bright new splash of rock and dust
A patch of ground about 6.4 km wide that stays colder at night
options: Ice found at the Moon’s south pole
A space rock carves a new crater on the Moon
games.why: LRO’s cameras caught a new 222 m crater. Its thermal instrument, Diviner, then found a cold zone about 6.4 km wide around it, where the impact had fluffed up the soil.
sources: NASA Science · Crater and cold spot

games.label: WHAT CHANGED FIRST?
games.title: Put these in order.
items: Two studies on the crater appear in Science Advances
A space rock slams into the Moon
An image specialist spots the new crater
games.why: The impact happened between 11 April and 22 May 2024. Robert Wagner spotted the crater on 24 October 2025. The two Science Advances papers were published on 16 September 2026.
sources: Deseret News · Published in Science Advances

games.label: THE BIGGER PICTURE
games.title: Why are scientists so excited about McGetchin crater?
options: It proves the Moon still has active volcanoes
It shows one impact can disturb the ground far beyond the crater itself
It means the Moon is drifting towards Earth
It is the first crater ever seen forming on another world
games.why: It is the largest newly formed crater yet found in the solar system, and the impact loosened the soil over an area kilometres wide. That is useful to know when planning future Moon bases.
sources: NASA APOD · Area much larger than crater
Universe Today · Lessons for lunar habitats
NASA Science · Cold spot around the crater

games.label: THE BIGGER PICTURE
games.title: What did the latest US jobs report, published on 2 October, show?
options: Employers added just 29,000 jobs in September, far fewer than expected
A record 500,000 new jobs in a single month
The number of jobs fell for a sixth month in a row
games.why: Forecasters had expected somewhere between 84,000 and 90,000 new jobs. The unemployment rate was 4.2%, and the figures for July and August were revised down by a combined 60,000. Health care, construction and manufacturing added jobs, while financial firms cut them.
sources: US Bureau of Labor Statistics · Employment Situation Summary
